text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~♪
I feel so, soooo good!
choice_data_list: Is it because I've gotten stronger?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I can feel how much I've grown, buuut~...
I figured out something really important!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want to surprise you,
Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want to totally
surprise big sis!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Something might happen on the day
of the Sprinters Stakes...♪
Look forward to it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! I heard there's
a secret gelato shop near here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
One of my fans mentioned it in a comment,
and now I'm super curious~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren worked hard on training...
Can I drop by secretly?

There is still time before the bus departs.
Asking for the location, it seems to be within walking distance.
In that case...
choice_data_list: Then it's time for a reward!
Then it's time for a reward!

text_block_list.text:
Savoring the delicious gelato,
the heated summer training camp came to a close.
